event.piper_heart2.0.text: [player]! Up here. Learn one chord with me. Just one. It's the friendly one.
event.piper_heart2.0.why: invites, with a promise she will break

event.piper_heart2.1.text: Thumb there, two fingers there, now pull. ...There. You're a musician now. That's the whole secret.

event.piper_heart2.2.text: Here, a sunflower for your first gig. Don't quit the farm. Come back Friday, and I'll teach you the second chord.

event.piper_heart5.0.text: Sit. This one's yours. Nobody requested it, which is how you know it's special.
event.piper_heart5.0.why: a gift disguised as a boast

event.piper_heart5.1.text: First time out of the case. Elara hasn't heard it yet, and she hears everything first.
event.piper_heart5.1.why: specific: the song's real first audience

event.piper_heart5.2.text: It ends on four notes I hum when nobody's around. I don't know where I got them. I keep meaning to find out.

event.hall_dance.4.text: First verse, then I step off. I'm perfectly calm. My bow hand hasn't heard.

event.story_umbrella.intro.text: Wait. Stop. Is that my umbrella? On a fence? Being useful without me?

dlg.story.umbrella.talk.0.text: A large red umbrella hangs open on the fence post, dripping with great dignity. Piper points at it.

dlg.story.umbrella.talk.1.text: Third time it's wandered off. It always turns up drier than I do. What do we do?
dlg.story.umbrella.talk.1.why: specific count, a joke, then the ask

dlg.story.umbrella.talk.r0.text: Reunited! I'd write it a song, but it would wander off mid-verse.
dlg.story.umbrella.talk.r0.why: joy, then a punchline on the umbrella

dlg.story.umbrella.talk.r1.text: Leave it? ...Yes. A little red landmark. Somebody out in this rain needs it more.

dlg.story.umbrella.talk.r2.text: You're keeping it? That's theft with excellent manners. ...It does suit you.
dlg.story.umbrella.talk.r2.why: tease aimed at the act, then warmth

event.story_umbrella.after.text: {if choice:umbrella.return}Back where it belongs. But someone keeps hanging it up so neatly. Who tidies a stranger's umbrella?{else}{if choice:umbrella.hang}A landmark. I'll look for it every rain. And whoever keeps hanging it there, I'll catch them humming.{else}Shared custody. I accept, under protest. Bring it Fridays so it hears me play.{/if}{/if}
event.story_umbrella.after.why: each branch leaves a small question or a day

event.story_band_battle.intro.text: Two bands, one square, one extremely polite war. Judge us, [player]. Be honest. Honest means fiddle.

dlg.story.band.talk.0.text: Exhibit A: one fiddle, one voice, a lifetime of practice. Try not to swoon.

dlg.story.band.talk.3.text: Well? Who owns the square tonight? Take your time. Pick the fiddle.

dlg.story.band.talk.r0.text: Justice! And good taste! Juno, you were wonderful. Just less fiddle.
dlg.story.band.talk.r0.why: gracious winner, never mocks a musician

dlg.story.band.talk.r2.text: Together? ...That's either genius or a noise complaint. Bram, one hit. Make it count.

event.story_band_battle.after.text: {if choice:band.piper}The fiddle wins! Juno took it beautifully. She's already forging a louder anvil.{else}{if choice:band.juno}The forge band wins! I'm thrilled. I'm furious. I'm writing a song about both.{else}A joint set! Fiddle, anvils, and one crowd clapping on every beat. That's a chorus.{/if}{/if}
event.story_band_battle.after.why: each result lands on her own reaction

event.piper_heart4.intro.text: Last set, and I'm out of ideas. You pick. Anything. I'll play it like I wrote it.

dlg.piper.request.0.text: The room's waiting. A ballad, a jig, or my parsnip masterpiece? Choose wisely. Choose parsnips.

dlg.piper.request.r0.text: A ballad. Sad in the middle, happy at the end. Like a good harvest. Gather round.

dlg.piper.request.r1.text: A jig! Mind your boots. The good stool's been waiting all night to dance.

dlg.piper.request.r2.text: The parsnip song! You have taste. Questionable, magnificent taste.

event.piper_heart4.after.text: {if choice:request.ballad}A ballad, slow, with one high note I'm saving. I'm writing down that you asked. It matters later.{else}{if choice:request.jig}A jig! Feet, take cover. I'm writing your request down. Don't ask why yet.{else}The parsnip song, with feeling and a straight face. I'm keeping this request. Someday I'll play it back.{/if}{/if}
event.piper_heart4.after.why: plants that the request returns at heart 10

event.piper_heart6.intro.text: Down here. The cellar. I'm not hiding. I'm resting my nerves among the barrels. They're very supportive.

dlg.piper.fright.0.text: I can play for a hundred people and never blink. Tonight I think they'll finally notice. I'm not as good as I say.

dlg.piper.fright.1.text: So. What do I do with that?

dlg.piper.fright.r0.text: Talk. Okay. I'm scared of quiet. Of being a good player and a forgettable writer. There. It's on the barrel now.

dlg.piper.fright.r1.text: ...You didn't fill it. Nobody ever leaves the quiet alone around me. It's not so bad, shared.
dlg.piper.fright.r1.why: the silence she fears, made bearable

dlg.piper.fright.r2.text: A bucket? You're drumming on a bucket? ...Okay. Okay! In four. One, two, three...

event.piper_heart6.after.text: The nerves are still here, just smaller. They fit in the fiddle case. Someday I want a song they sing without me. Tonight, I'll go up.
event.piper_heart6.after.why: states her want, points at heart 10

event.piper_heart8.intro.text: Sit by the stage. I'm writing a song, and I need you on every line. It's the only way it'll be good.

dlg.piper.chorus.r0.text: Home. ...Oh. That's it. I've been missing that word for three months. It was right here.

dlg.piper.chorus.r1.text: The road. Wide and honest. It rhymes with 'code', if you squint.

dlg.piper.chorus.r2.text: This room! A song about the saloon. The good stool is going to be unbearable.

event.piper_heart8.after.text: {if choice:chorus.home}'Home' in the chorus. Of course. Now it needs a room full of people to sing it without me.{else}{if choice:chorus.road}'The road' in the chorus. Wanderers love a road. Now it needs a room to sing it without me.{else}'This room' in the chorus. Cheeky and right. Now the room has to sing it without me.{/if}{/if}
event.piper_heart8.after.why: each branch points at the payoff

event.piper_heart10.intro.text: Tonight we play the song we wrote. I'll start it. After the first verse, I step off. Don't let me climb back on.

event.piper_heart10.outro.text: {if choice:chorus.home}They sang 'home' without me. All of them. I didn't play a note. ...So that's what quiet sounds like.{else}{if choice:chorus.road}They sang the road back to me, every verse. I just stood and listened. Quiet's not so bad.{else}The room sang itself back to the room. Even the good stool joined in. I only had to stand there.{/if}{/if}
event.piper_heart10.outro.why: payoff: the silence she feared, now full

event.piper_friend.intro.text: Friday! Come hear the parsnip ballad. Four verses, and one's about the gray cat. It hasn't approved its verse.
event.piper_friend.intro.why: specific, a joke on the cat

event.piper_friend.doing.text: 'Oh parsnip, pale and patient root...' Wait. It rhymes with 'boot'. If you squint. I'm very close.

event.piper_friend.wrap.text: That's a chorus! A bad one. Mine. Come back next Friday. Verse five is about you.

adds.text: That chord took me a week. You took a minute. I'm fine. I'm completely fine about it.
If it's bad, clap anyway. If it's good, clap louder. I'm flexible.
adds.why: covers nerves with a joke before playing

adds.text: And Bram tapped his foot on the second verse. I saw it. He'll deny it until spring.
